metadata.title: टिपरामोथा त्रिपुरा बंद करे तो मानें - बीजेपी | Tipra Motha Bandh call has no meaning - BJP
metadata.description: The main opposition party has given a call to shut down tribal areas on 30th September 2023. The party says it wants to demand greater Tipraland for tribals. But not only the ruling BJP but other opposition parties have questioned Tipra Motha's politics in Tripura. While BJP alleges that Tipra Motha is confused other political parties say Tipra Motha is indirectly helping BJP only.
